title: 'Norman Rockwell Paints Modern America'
content: It's been a while since I posted about AI art, and it's amazing how far it has come.These images appeared onTwitter (X)under the title: "Norman Rockwell Paints Modern America."This one is called "Body Count."I’m struck not only by the coherence of the images and the accuracy of the “1940s Illustration Propaganda” style, but by the high-level satirical insights about our culture's foibles.Does anyone know, was this generated with Dall-e3, and what were the prompts?
